amendment.cascade: k_label_panels.csv (9,000 rows: 9 test lines x 20 panels x 50 labels) was regenerated wholesale from the 587-gene pool using the original per-panel seeds and draw rule (34/9000 rows referenced the 2 dropped genes; surgical row deletion would have broken the frozen N_LABELS=50 invariant, so panels were regenerated in full, deterministically, rather than patched).
amendment.measurement: Phase D Task 0 (.superpowers/sdd/phase-d/task-0-coverage.md): read-only union-vocabulary coverage check against the real HPC Perturb-seq sources found 587/589 slice genes reachable (alias-corrected: CRIPTO=TDGF1 and HEMK2=N6AMT1 resolve under current HGNC symbols in all four anchors and are NOT removed; only FOXO3B and MRPL12 have no hit under any spelling).
amendment.reason: FOXO3B and MRPL12 are never targeted (under any spelling or known HGNC alias) in any of the four Perturb-seq anchor libraries (K562 GWPS, Jurkat, HepG2, HCT116 X-Atlas-Orion), so the closed-vocabulary PerturbationVectorAdapter cannot score them and slice.complete_case_required=True makes a partial table a contract violation. Phase A defined the slice from DepMap cross-line variance without checking ST-vocabulary reachability; this amendment corrects that oversight in the contract's construction, not a statistical re-derivation -- training_std/training_dependency_prevalence/training_line_count for the retained 587 genes, and the variance_cutoff/eligible_before_variance_filter that defined the original 589-gene selection, are unchanged.
amendment.timing: This amendment predates any Phase D result: no Phase D prediction, evaluation, or checkpoint exists yet on this branch. It is registered before any held-out GeneEffect label is opened for the amended slice, so it is a contract correction, not a post-hoc goalpost move.
amendment.unchanged: cell_line_manifest.csv (role assignment, test-line identities), differentially_essential_slice.csv's 587 retained rows (byte-identical), slice.variance_cutoff, slice.eligible_before_variance_filter, seed, sources.*, estimator.*, rho_min, rho_min_justification.*, batch_confound_sensitivity.*, phase_a_gate_evidence.*, training_proxy_line_deltas.csv, and rho_min_power_simulation.csv are all untouched by this amendment.

batch_confound_sensitivity.batch_matched_head: retrain the GeneEffect head without the four Perturb-seq anchor lines, using Tahoe-source head-training lines only; ST response training on the four anchors is unchanged
batch_confound_sensitivity.gate_policy: primary unadjusted estimator remains the sole gate; both fixed sensitivities are reported and cannot replace it
batch_confound_sensitivity.lineage_balanced_estimate: unweighted mean of the six held-out-lineage mean paired effects
batch_confound_sensitivity.not_used: no line-level source covariate adjustment because source is constant across all held-out Tahoe lines

design: Tx1-conditioned ST GeneEffect backbone Phase A

estimator.adapter_freeze_boundary: adapter architecture and hyperparameters are selected using training lines only in Phase E and hashed before any held-out GeneEffect label is opened; all methods use the same panels
estimator.gate: at k=10, bootstrap lower bound must exceed rho_min
estimator.k_label_sampling: 20 fixed nested panels per held-out line; panel seeds and ordered genes are materialized in k_label_panels.csv; k uses the first k
estimator.panel_aggregation: mean Spearman within line across 20 panels, then paired method difference; bootstrap only the nine line-level means
estimator.population_estimate: unweighted macro mean over held-out lines
estimator.scored_genes: differential slice minus that panel's k labels; target/prediction pairwise complete cases, minimum 100 genes

exposure.held_out_tx1_pretraining: known present for every Tahoe test line

omics_expression_missing_policy: ACH-001039 remains a Tahoe training line for Tx1/HVG/pseudobulk heads but is excluded from the CCLE-bulk baseline; no expression imputation

batch_audit.audit_scope: paired Tahoe-DMSO pseudobulk versus DepMap/CCLE bulk
batch_audit.interpretation_limit: This crossed-source proxy identifies source separation independently of cell-line identity; it is not a direct Perturb-seq-control versus Tahoe comparison because those sources have no overlapping lines.
batch_audit.registered_response: Keep the unadjusted estimator as the sole gate; additionally report a Tahoe-only head-training sensitivity and a lineage-balanced macro estimate. Do not fit a line-level source covariate because every held-out line has the Tahoe source.

tx1_source_manifest.label_resolution: The official 3b-model artifact is selected explicitly; the top-level or legacy tx-70m-merged label is not accepted as the 3B encoder.

tx1_width_verification.attention_implementation: torch portability fallback for the width probe; weights and output shape are unchanged

rho_min_justification.decision_alternative_rule: training proxy mean minus one half between-line SD, rounded to 0.01; no clipping or post-power tuning
rho_min_justification.noise_source: training-only nearest-expression-line vs copy-K562 paired rho deltas
rho_min_justification.selection_rule: rho_min is fixed by utility; simulation must show >=80% power at the training-derived conservative decision alternative or Phase A fails
rho_min_justification.utility_derivation: floor(0.10 * 0.554 * 100) / 100 = 0.05; 0.554 is the previously observed HCT116 retained GeneEffect transfer rho, and one tenth is the prespecified smallest worthwhile rank lift
